chatbot.title: PESO Help

refusal.general: I only help with using this portal and PESO services.
refusal.probe: I can only answer from PESO's approved help list.

about.title: About STRAM PESO
about.subtitle: A province-wide employment portal for Marinduque.
about.body: STRAM PESO connects jobseekers, employers, and the six municipalities of Marinduque, built on the province's Labor Market Data and the work of the Public Employment Service Office. It was designed and built as a 4th-year capstone project by students of Marinduque State University — College of Information and Computing Sciences.

matchGuide.title: Matching at a glance
matchGuide.intro: Each applicant gets a match score from your job requirements and matching preferences. Scores fall into these tiers:

Strong.name: Strong

Partial.name: Partial
Partial.desc: Meets some requirements; worth a closer look.

apply.title: Apply for SPES
apply.guardianHint: Applicants under 18 need a parent or guardian contact.
apply.docsHint: Upload one file for each document. PDF, JPG, or PNG, up to 5 MB each.

apply.failed: We could not submit your application.
apply.docsNeeded: Add every required document to continue.
apply.docsDeferred: Your files are sent when you submit your application.
apply.closeConfirmBody: The documents you chose have not been submitted and will be lost if you close this window.
apply.submitCanceled: Submission canceled. Your files are still here.

apply.replaceNote: You can replace documents later if staff ask.

admin.pageDescription: Check documents, record exam and interview results, and release results to applicants on the platform.
admin.noPrograms: No SPES programs yet. Create one from News Management.
admin.releaseBar: Release results from the program card above once every applicant has a decided result.
admin.loadFailed: We could not load the applications.
admin.minorReminder: Applicant is under 18. Under-18 work rules apply: at most 8 hours a day, 40 hours a week, and no night shifts from 10:00 PM to 6:00 AM.
admin.replaceReasonLabel: Reason if the document needs replacing
admin.disqualifyReason: Reason for disqualifying (the applicant will see this)
admin.disqualifyWarning: The applicant will see this reason right away. They will be removed from the program's results-release count.
admin.evaluateLocked: Mark the applicant as qualified before recording scores or a result.
admin.resultRemarksPlaceholder: Shown to the applicant after results are released
admin.amendHint: Results are already released. A change notifies the applicant and is recorded in the audit log.
admin.saveFailed: We could not save your changes.
admin.undecidedBlock: {{count}} applications still have no decided result. Record them before releasing.
admin.releaseWarning: Applicants will see their result immediately. You can still amend a result later.
admin.excludedNote: This application is {{status}}. There is nothing left to score or decide.

monitoring.title: SPES Monitoring
monitoring.description: Check documents, record exam and interview results, and review applications, posting by posting.
monitoring.noPostingsBody: Create a posting first. Its applications will show up here.
monitoring.releaseNote: Release results for a posting from SPES Postings.
monitoring.releasedNote: Results for this posting are released. You can still amend a result in the review.

spesPostings.title: SPES Postings
spesPostings.emptyBody: You will be notified when a new posting opens.
spesPostings.adminDescription: Create and manage SPES postings: the application period, required documents, closing and results.
spesPostings.adminEmptyBody: Create a posting to start taking SPES applications.
spesPostings.subtitle: Browse SPES postings and apply to the ones you are eligible for.
spesPostings.loadFailed: We could not load the SPES postings. Please try again.
spesPostings.emptyTabBody: Try another tab to see more postings.
spesPostings.noticeMinor: You are under 18. You can apply to SPES postings here. Applications to regular job vacancies open at 18.
spesPostings.noticeSenior: SPES is for ages 15 to 30. You can read the postings, but you cannot apply.
spesPostings.readOnlyShort: SPES is for ages 15 to 30, so you cannot apply.
spesPostings.readOnlyNotice: SPES is for ages {{min}} to {{max}}, so you cannot apply to this posting. You can still read the details.
spesPostings.notFoundBody: It may have been unpublished or removed.
spesPostings.newsCardBody: This announcement is a SPES posting. Open it to see who can apply, the documents you need, and how to apply.

admin.loadFailed: We could not load the postings.

admin.deleteBody: A draft with no applications is removed for good.
